explanation: Mathlib has the analogous facts only for the structure sheaf (an instance for Γ(X, ⊥) in AlgebraicGeometry/Scheme.lean, and one for IsEmpty X in AlgebraicGeometry/Limits.lean), and these are about ring sections. I found nothing for sections of a Scheme.Modules sheaf over an empty scheme. I searched for subsingleton/IsEmpty lemmas in Modules, ModuleCat/Sheaf and Topology/Sheaves. Mathlib supplies only the ingredients isTerminalOfEqEmpty and AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero, and the proof combines these with a few extra steps.
